title: Al-Fatihah: a conversation with Allah: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Understanding the Qur'an and teaching
source: Written for quran/y11 lesson 5 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Fatihah rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 5. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

head: 1:1-4: who Allah is
1:5-7: what we ask
rows: Not the path of the astray

arabic.text: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ (١) ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ (٢) ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ (٣) مَٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ (٤) إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ (٥) ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ (٦) صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ (٧)

panels.title: The meanings
points: Translation of the meaning, not the Qur'an itself

keywords.def: humble presence of heart in prayer
a hadith in which the Prophet ﷺ reports Allah's words

questions.q: In the portal response box, write what 1:6 asks for and why we ask it in every rak'ah. Start: 'In 1:6 we ask ...'
questions.a: We ask for guidance to the straight path; we need it constantly, in every decision.

questions.q: Tadabbur (Forms long answer): choose one ayah of Al-Fatihah and write how it should change your salah this week. Today's rota group recites Al-Fatihah with the tajweed rubric (mock feedback).
questions.a: A paragraph naming the ayah, its meaning and one practical change.

questions.q: Extend: give Allah's reply to 1:2, 1:3 and 1:4 from the hadith.
questions.a: My servant has praised Me; My servant has extolled Me; My servant has glorified Me.

questions.q: Which ayah is shared between Allah and the servant (worship and asking help)?
questions.a: A) 1:5. 1:5: 'It is You we worship and You we ask for help.'

questions.q: The first half of Al-Fatihah is about ...
Think again: We recite Al-Fatihah at least 17 times a day. After mocks and a busy term, how can it stay fresh rather than automatic?
questions.a: By knowing Allah answers each ayah, pausing between ayat, and thinking about what we ask.
